name: GRXTOR
description: Abdullah Hüseyin Efe (GRXTOR) — Web Designer & Music Producer. Founder of The Lost Label — Brazilian Funk & Phonk.
summary: I'm GRXTOR (Abdullah Hüseyin Efe), a web designer and music producer based in Turkey. I run [The Lost Label](https://thelostlabel.com), an independent music label releasing Brazilian Funk and Phonk music. I design and build websites for music brands — including [thelostlabel.com](https://thelostlabel.com) and [elysianrecords.com](https://elysianrecords.com). When I'm not behind a screen, I'm producing Brazilian Funk tracks and pushing new sounds.
